composition_subtypes.role: generate all bitmasks with k set bits
count pairs via XOR and frequency dictionary

payload.core_composition_summary: Enumerate all 15-bit numbers with k set bits, then for each distinct value, XOR with each mask to find partners in a frequency map, counting pairs and dividing by 2.
payload.rationale: The solution combines brute-force bitmask enumeration (complete search) with XOR-based partner lookup (bit manipulation) to efficiently count k-interesting pairs.
